title: Resolution urging Albany to extend tax breaks for HDFC co-ops
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, A.2707A/S.880A to help preserve affordable Housing Development Fund Corporation (HDFC) cooperatives. The bill would make permanent a property tax exemption set to expire in 2029 and let HDFCs choose a larger tax abatement, and would let the city forgive tax arrears for HDFCs that accept greater oversight. There are about 1,048 HDFCs in New York City housing roughly 75,000 residents.
